Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  21.07. ABA No.564 of 2023  2023 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This is an Application, filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with the First Information Report No.397 of 2023, registered at police station Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.

2. Heard Mr. Abhishek Verma, learned counsel for the applicant and Ms. Manisha Rana Singh,
learned AGA with Ms. Shivali Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3.
Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate, contended that the First Information Report was registered on 08.07.2023 for the alleged offence, committed in the month of May, 2013.
4. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that as per instructions, applicant did not receive any money from the informant.

However, she has sought four weeks' time to file objection(s) to the Anticipatory Bail Application.
5. List on 18.09.2023 for hearing on Anticipatory Bail Application.
6.

Having considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion as to the merit of the case, this Court directs that in the event of arrest, applicant - accused Rafeek Saifi Alias Rafeek Ahmad shall be released on Interim Anticipatory Bail on furnishing his personal bond of Rs. 30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer on the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person, acquainted with the facts of this case;
 (ii) Applicant shall cooperate with the  Investigating Agency and he will make  himself available at the time of ABA/564/2023 on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27935713/
1 interrogation by the Investigating Agency as and when requires.
( Alok Kumar Verma, J.) Pant/ 21.07.2023 ABA/564/2023 on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27935713/
